# Stellar AI

> Stellar AI writes game scripts for FiveM and Roblox from plain English. You describe what you want and it produces the script plus the fxmanifest, ready to drop into your resources folder. Built for server owners who cannot code.

Stellar AI is made by Stellar, a small UK company founded in 2026 by Tobi Milne, who runs a FiveM roleplay server and built the tool because he could not code the features he wanted.

## What it does

- Writes Lua scripts for FiveM servers from a plain English description
- Generates the matching `fxmanifest.lua` automatically
- Supports QBCore, ESX and standalone FiveM servers
- Also writes Luau scripts for Roblox
- Every script is downloadable as a file
- Includes install notes so non-coders know where to put things

## Who it is for

FiveM and Roblox server owners who want custom features but cannot write code themselves. The usual alternatives are paying a developer for each script, buying a pre-made resource that is not quite right, or giving up on the idea.

## Pricing

- **Free** — £0. Try it with no card required. Creating an account adds £1 of starter credit.
- **Plus** — £10 per month. More usage and longer scripts.
- **Pro** — £30 per month. Highest usage and access to the most capable model.
- **Credit top-ups** — one-off payments from 50p, usable on any plan. Bigger top-ups earn bonus credit.

Only one paid plan can be held at a time. Payments are handled by Stripe.

## Honest limitations

- It is an AI tool, so it does not replace a developer for large or complex systems.
- Generated code should be reviewed before being used on a live server.
- Longer scripts and generated images use more of your allowance than short answers.
